name: Molotov Cocktail
summary: Incendiary thrown weapon. Creates a burning pool on impact igniting enemies, vehicles, and terrain. Confirmed in Grassrivers combat sequences.
description: The Molotov Cocktail is a classic improvised incendiary device confirmed in GTA VI Grassrivers combat sequences. On impact it shatters and creates a persistent burning pool that ignites enemies, vehicles, and flammable terrain. The fire lingers for several seconds, area-denying chokepoints and flushing enemies from cover. Each throw consumes one unit from inventory.
